title: Parking Rectangle Algorithm Visualization
description: Dive into the fascinating world of geometric algorithms with this interactive visualization of the Parking Rectangle Algorithm 🚗. Designed for students, developers, and math enthusiasts, it breaks down the step-by-step process of efficiently packing rectangles into constrained spaces, mimicking real-world parking challenges in urban planning and logistics. Starting with foundational concepts like applying vertex template matrices, the tool demonstrates how rotations by angle θ optimize space utilization without overlaps or gaps 🔄. Watch as dynamic animations illustrate matrix transformations, boundary detection, and iterative adjustments to achieve maximal density 📊. Key features include adjustable parameters for rectangle sizes, rotation angles, and parking lot dimensions, allowing users to experiment and observe performance metrics like packing efficiency and computation time. Perfect for educational purposes, this visualization highlights practical applications in computer graphics, robotics path planning, and supply chain optimization, making abstract math tangible and exciting. Explore how subtle angle tweaks can transform inefficient layouts into streamlined solutions, all with intuitive controls and explanatory tooltips 📈.
